name: Mid-sized mammals
description: Mid-sized mammals, mostly omnivores. Functional group pooling six source compartments: opossum, raccoon, gray fox, mink, river otter and Florida black bear, aggregated because the source tracked each as a small mid-trophic mammal compartment. The pooled diet mixes plants, mast and insects (bear, raccoon, opossum) with crayfish, prawns and fish (otter, mink).
